name: Striking Modern Sanctuary
description: A modern architectural retreat blending refined interiors with expansive outdoor living. Thoughtfully designed for elevated everyday living, every detail reflects timeless luxury and tailored craftsmanship.

name: Naturally Modern
source: Haley Custom Homes project page (haleycustomhomes.com/project/lowe); location and year: Houzz project listing (houzz.com/professionals/home-builders/haley-custom-homes-pfvwus-pf~1703183129)
tagline: A retreat in rhythm with nature
description: Modern, warm, and grounded in nature, this custom home is a study in balance. Stone, wood and steel come together in clean lines and open spaces, creating a sanctuary that's both design-forward and deeply livable. From the vaulted kitchen to the private courtyard and pool, every detail supports a lifestyle that's connected, intentional, and beautifully built.

name: House of Tranquility
source: Haley Custom Homes project page (haleycustomhomes.com/project/2026/9/8/19-chp); location: the photographer's file names (19 Cherry Hills Parkway)
description: A timeless estate nestled among mature trees in the heart of Cherry Hills, this residence embodies quiet luxury and architectural grace. With a warm, grounded palette of natural stone, wood, and light, the home unfolds in elegant symmetry, inviting you through softly lit corridors, soaring glass, and serene, sculptural spaces. From the grand entry to the spa-like bath retreat, every detail is thoughtfully composed to balance form and function, delivering a sanctuary that feels both refined and deeply livable.

name: Heaven at Sunset
description: This residence blends timeless architecture with modern luxury, creating a home that feels both refined and inviting. The interiors are filled with natural light and softened by organic textures: wood beams, stone accents, and layered neutrals. From the chef's kitchen with sculptural lighting and custom cabinetry to the serene primary suite with a cozy window seat, every space is thoughtfully designed for comfort and elegance.

name: Timeless Estate
source: Haley Custom Homes project page (haleycustomhomes.com/project/fisher); location and year: Houzz project listing (houzz.com/professionals/home-builders/haley-custom-homes-pfvwus-pf~1703183129)
description: This estate is a timeless expression of handcrafted architecture, where steep gables, stone terraces, and rich millwork evoke the elegance of a European manor. Inside, custom finishes and tailored spaces bring warmth and personality to every room. For clients who value legacy, detail, and design with story, this is a home that speaks to something deeper: a sense of place, permanence, and craftsmanship that lasts.

name: Tradition Reimagined
source: Haley Custom Homes project page (haleycustomhomes.com/project/2026/9/8/walker); location and year: Houzz project listing (houzz.com/professionals/home-builders/haley-custom-homes-pfvwus-pf~1703183129)
tagline: Designed for today. Built for generations.
description: This home reflects what's possible when timeless architecture meets purposeful design. It blends enduring materials, expansive mountain views, and livable luxury in every space, from the grand gabled exteriors to the natural light-filled interiors. Thoughtful scale, seamless flow, and refined finishes turn everyday living into an elevated experience: a home grounded in tradition but tailored for modern life.

name: Modern Elevated
source: Haley Custom Homes project page (haleycustomhomes.com/project/beckman); location and year: Houzz project listing (houzz.com/professionals/home-builders/haley-custom-homes-pfvwus-pf~1703183129)
tagline: Sculpted for the skyline. Styled for life.
description: Bold architectural lines with warm, natural materials for a home that feels both striking and livable. Expansive glass walls erase the boundary between indoor comfort and outdoor beauty, while clean finishes, sculptural elements, and polished concrete floors give the space a refined, modern sensibility. Every detail is intentional and every view is maximized.

name: Simplicity Perfected
source: Haley Custom Homes project page (haleycustomhomes.com/project/polzin); location and year: Houzz project listing (houzz.com/professionals/home-builders/haley-custom-homes-pfvwus-pf~1703183129)
description: This home redefines modern elegance with its clean lines, curated natural materials, and seamless indoor-outdoor flow. Centered around a tranquil courtyard and reflection pool, the residence is designed for privacy, serenity, and elevated entertaining. Sculptural plantings, custom woodwork and floor-to-ceiling glass foster a peaceful connection to nature, while bold architectural details deliver a striking first impression.

name: Curated House
source: Haley Custom Homes project page (haleycustomhomes.com/project/mcdonald); category, location, year and description: Houzz project listing (houzz.com/professionals/home-builders/haley-custom-homes-pfvwus-pf~1703183129) (listed there as Cherry Creek Historical Remodel)
description: A comprehensive remodel of a historic Cherry Creek home, finished in 2022. The work reached nearly every room: the kitchen, dining and living spaces, the staircase and hall, bedrooms and baths, a powder room, a home bar and a wine cellar.

name: Endlessly Charming
source: Haley Custom Homes project page (haleycustomhomes.com/project/2026/9/8/boland); category: Haley's LUXE Interiors + Design feature of this transitional remodel (photography Emily Minton Redfield)
tagline: Where timeless character meets custom comfort
description: A love letter to timeless architecture and approachable elegance. Classic materials, hand-washed brick, dark hardwoods, and soft hues blend with tailored details and layered textures, creating a home that feels warm, personal, and deeply lived in. From the welcoming front path to the light-filled kitchen and charming private spaces, it shows what's possible when custom building is done with care, character, and intention.
